recentItems.title: క్షతగాత్రురాలిని తన కారులో ఆసుపత్రికి తరలించిన మంత్రి | Minister Durgesh Helps Accident Victim
recentItems.description:
Minister Kandula Durgesh won widespread appreciation for displaying exemplary humanity when he immediately stopped his convoy to rescue a severely injured woman in a lorry-bike collision near Vizzheswaram. While en route to inspect flood-prone areas of Errakaluva in Nidadavolu, East Godavari district, the minister rushed to the accident spot, comforted the victim, and personally arranged to shift her to the Nidadavolu Government Hospital in his convoy vehicle. Locals and netizens are heavily praising the minister's prompt response and kind gesture on the road.
